subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T16:12:00-04:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — Redwood Inference

Hi Lydia —

Great to meet you earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps to kick off the security questionnaire: 

Recap / context:
- ClearBridge Health is evaluating Redwood for inference (hosted + private deployment options) to power clinical summarization in production.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 compliance, HIPAA handling (PHI), data residency, and third-party risk (subprocessors).

Next steps I'd like to start today:
1) We can fill your SIG/CAIQ, or if you prefer we can send our SIG spreadsheet for you to review. I attached our Redwood_SIG_v2.xlsx to speed things up.
2) I've attached a short SOC 2 summary (SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf) — we are SOC 2 Type II for our production inference service (report available under NDA).
3) Please confirm the scope you want for the questionnaire (production-only, production + staging, or full org). Also confirm whether ClearBridge will need a BAA in place before the questionnaire is reviewed.
4) If there are any procurement or legal contacts who should be on the thread, please loop them in.

Clarifying questions for you (so we answer the SIG accurately):
- Is PHI expected to be processed in production for the initial rollout?
- Do you require data residency in a specific US region (e.g., us-east-1) or EU?
- Any minimum encryption or key management controls we should call out (KMS/HSM requirement)?

Proposed timeline: we can return a completed SIG/CAIQ within ~7\u201310 business days after you confirm scope and any mandatory questions. If you'd like, Jordan (cc'd) can hop on a short call to go through the technical parts.

Thanks — I'll wait for your confirmation on scope and any additional contacts.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf (doc stub)

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T18:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side before you fill the SIG: 

1) Scope: For now we want production + any environments that may process PHI (so production + secure staging). Please indicate production/staging explicitly in the questionnaire responses.

2) Data residency: Data must remain in the US for our initial rollout (we prefer us-east region but can accept other US regions if contractually required).

3) PHI: Yes, our initial integration will include PHI in free-text clinical notes. We will require a signed BAA before any PHI is processed. Can you confirm Redwood's BAA posture?

4) Encryption / KMS: We use customer-managed keys for other vendors. Do you support CMKs / HSM-backed keys for tenant-level isolation? If not, what controls do you provide?

5) Subprocessors / third parties: Please include a list or link to your current subprocessors and any planned changes in the next 90 days.

6) Timeline & format: We prefer a completed CAIQ, but the SIG spreadsheet is fine if you can return it with attachments for controls evidence. If you can provide example answers for the items flagged as "high-risk" (e.g., PHI handling, key management, breach notification SLA), that will speed our internal review.

Looping in Alex Rivera from procurement to help coordinate contract/BAA timing.

Can you confirm you can meet the BAA requirement and that you can complete the SIG/CAIQ in ~10 business days for production+staging scope?

Best,
Lydia Chen
Director, Security & Compliance | ClearBridge Health
lydia.chen@clearbridgehealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0127

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — Redwood Inference

Hi Lydia / Alex —

Thanks for the clarity — great questions. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Answers / confirmations:
- BAA: Yes — Redwood will sign a BAA. We have a standard BAA and legal is prepared to start review. We can provide a draft once procurement confirms the preferred contract flow.
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report period ended Oct 2024). We attached a one-page SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf; full report available under NDA.
- Environments / scope: We will mark production + secure staging in the SIG responses as requested.
- PHI: Supported. We will treat PHI as in-scope and will include our PHI handling controls and incident procedures in the responses.
- Data residency: We support US-only data residency. We can commit to us-east region for your rollout; will call that out in the SIG and in the contract language.
- Key management: We support KMS-based encryption. For tenant-level CMKs / HSM-backed keys, we offer an enterprise key management option (integrates with customer's KMS/HSM via partner/managed keys). Jordan (cc'd) can give the technical details and options on the call.
- Subprocessors: We'll include the current subprocessors list and any planned updates (none planned in next 90 days) and provide links to the public subprocessors registry.

Attachments included in this reply: Redwood_SIG_v2.xlsx (completed where possible) and SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf. The SIG has a couple of items flagged that Jordan will complete with technical detail.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- If procurement/legal confirm they want a draft BAA, we'll push ours within 2 business days.
- We will complete the SIG/CAIQ for production+staging and return within 7\u201310 business days after BAA confirmation.
- Jordan can schedule a 30\u201345 minute technical Q&A this week to go through KMS, network isolation, and PHI controls. Please share 2\u20133 times that work for your team.

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite for the technical call and route the completed SIG back to this thread when ready.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

—
